use_cases: Landing page entry point to showcase product value and brand identity
First impression hero for SaaS and tech product websites
Premium onboarding section for digital platforms
Marketing campaign landing pages with animated visual appeal
Portfolio and creative agency showcase sections
ai_summary: A premium hero section component featuring floating geometric shapes with glass-morphism styling, ambient animations, and elegant fade-up text transitions. The design uses backdrop blur effects, gradient borders, and subtle glow shadows to create a sophisticated, modern aesthetic ideal for tech and SaaS landing pages. Fully responsive with configurable badge and title props.
